none: PAS NLM-9D6BF3: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), probably Gloria Exercitus issue of 335-341, possibly a copy, Reece period 17. Chipped. Obverse description: Bust right. Reverse description: Possibly two soldiers with one standard between them. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA EXERCITVS]. Diameter: 13.4mm, Weight: 0.64gms, die axis: possibly 6
